transcriptTurns.speaker: The Clarifier
transcriptTurns.text: Hey Omar, it's The Clarifier. Checking in for our 3-minute momentum block. What is the single highest-leverage bottleneck in front of you today?

transcriptTurns.speaker: Omar
transcriptTurns.text: Honestly, I'm stuck between redesigning the landing page and finishing the API contract for the hackathon submission. I keep jumping between both.

transcriptTurns.speaker: The Clarifier
transcriptTurns.text: Context-switching is just another form of avoidance. Which of those two makes the other completely irrelevant if it isn't finished today?

transcriptTurns.speaker: Omar
transcriptTurns.text: The API contract. Without the working build, the landing page doesn't even matter.

transcriptTurns.speaker: The Clarifier
transcriptTurns.text: Exactly. What can you ship on that API contract in a dedicated 90-minute focus block before 5:00 PM?

transcriptTurns.speaker: Omar
transcriptTurns.text: I will silence all notifications, lock myself in, and finalize the core endpoint schema and push the production build by 5:00 PM.

transcriptTurns.speaker: The Clarifier
transcriptTurns.text: Locked in. 5:00 PM API build. I'll ring you back at 5:00 to verify completion. You know what to do—put the phone down and go execute.
